input.plan:
# AXEL Item-by-Item Workflow (Starting with All Common Items)

## 1) Inferred Intent

- User goal: run one focused agent chat per item to avoid context bloat, while still building toward full multi-item synergy.
- Confirmed scope: start with **all Common items in order** from [AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/combat/AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md): `C1..C10`, then `C-A..C-H`.
- Confirmed dev constraint: dev picker must support a **max of 7 items**, but each early chat may ship one new item; from item #2 onward, verify new item coexists with already-shipped items.

## 2) Canon Alignment Check

- Canon source order and invariants come from [AI_DOCS.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md).
- Combat item order/source of truth is [AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/combat/AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md).
- QA execution/persistence contract comes from [AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md), [AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md), and [axel-simulated-qa SKILL](.cursor/skills/axel-simulated-qa/SKILL.md).

## 3) Workflow Architecture (Per Item Chat)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  startItem[PickNextItemFromCatalog] --> planItem[TechnicalPlanForSingleItem]
  planItem --> implementItem[ImplementItemEffectAndHooks]
  implementItem --> updateDevPicker[AddItemToDevPickerMax7]
  updateDevPicker --> runQa[RunQaAgentCombined]
  runQa --> synergyGate[RunSynergyChecksWithPriorItems]
  synergyGate --> logAndClose[AppendQaPayloadAndRefreshAnalytics]
```

## 4) Concrete File Targets (Primary)

- Catalog + order reference: [AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/combat/AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md)
- Combat runtime hooks: [combat_root.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd)
- Dev playtest UI/picker host: [combat_test.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd)
- Item audit harness: [item_balance_audit.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/test/item_balance_audit.gd)
- QA persistence outputs: [AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md), [AXEL_QA_ANALYTICS.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_ANALYTICS.md), [AXEL_QA_ANALYTICS.svg](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_ANALYTICS.svg)
- Changelog when implementation ships: [AI_CHANGELOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md)

## 5) Ordered Execution Protocol (Reuse in Every Item Chat)

1. **Select item by strict order** from the catalog queue (Common phase: `C1..C10`, then `C-A..C-H`).
2. **Item technical spec pass** for that item only:
   - trigger timing (spin start, line resolve, cascade, meter, Trinity Run, SUPER)
   - stacking rule (additive/multiplicative/capped, once-per-spin, priority)
   - conflict policy (must compose, not overwrite prior equipped-item effects).
3. **Implement item runtime behavior** in combat runtime and item definitions.
4. **Update dev picker list** so the new item is selectable; enforce max equipable slots = 7.
5. **Synergy baseline for this chat**:
   - Item #1: verify solo behavior + no-regression.
   - Item #2+: verify new item with at least one previously shipped item, then expand to representative stacked loadouts up to 7 over successive chats.
6. **Run `qa agent` (combined static + full playtest)** with required commands and conditional `item_balance_audit`.
7. **Persist QA artifacts** (append JSON payload in run log + regenerate analytics markdown/svg).
8. **Record implementation entry** in AI changelog, including any canon conflict resolution decisions.

## 6) Synergy Validation Strategy (Cross-Item, Cumulative)

- Maintain a cumulative compatibility rule: every newly added item must preserve effects of previously added items (no effect erasure, no hook clobbering).
- Add/maintain deterministic synergy checks in combat tests to cover:
  - event ordering correctness when multiple item hooks trigger on same phase
  - cap/priority handling when two effects modify same scalar
  - stacked loadout smoke with increasing size toward 7 slots.
- Treat failed coexistence as `BUG`/`REGRESSION` blockers in QA findings.

## 7) Acceptance Criteria per Item Chat

- Item implemented according to catalog effect text and combat invariants.
- Item appears in dev picker and can be selected within max-7 system.
- New item works alone and with prior items (at least one stacked verification from item #2 onward).
- QA run completed using `qa agent` contract; payload appended; analytics regenerated.
- Changelog entry added for implemented item.

## 8) Risk & Fallback Notes

- Main risk: stacking side effects in shared phases (`_resolve_lines*`, `_apply_gravity_and_refill*`, meter/free-spin transitions).
- Mitigation: phase-specific hook boundaries + deterministic tests for hook order and cap logic.
- Fallback: if a new effect conflicts with existing stack rules, ship behind an item-specific guard and document temporary limitation in changelog + next chat backlog.

content.text:
All todos are complete. Here's a summary of everything implemented:

---

**Infrastructure delivered:**

1. **`item_def.gd`** — `ItemDef` resource class with `id`, `display_name`, `rarity`, `family`, `description`, `effect_id`, and `effect_params` dictionary for flexible effect configuration.

2. **`item_inventory.gd`** — `ItemInventory` class managing an equipped items array with max 7 slots, enforcing id-uniqueness on equip and providing `equip`/`unequip`/`set_all`/`has_item` methods.

3. **CombatRoot equip API** — `equip_item()`, `unequip_item()`, `set_equipped_items()` methods on `combat_root.gd`, wired to `ItemInventory`. Additive payout scalar via `_get_item_payout_scalar()` applied to all line payouts and grid-clear bonuses in both `spin()` and `spin_sync()`.

4. **C1 Ash Reroll Token** — First item data file at `combat/data/items/C1_ash_reroll_token.tres` with effect `reroll_payout_scalar` (+0.10x per paid spin, cap +0.60x).

5. **Dev picker UI** — Programmatic panel in `combat_test.gd` that auto-discovers items from `res://combat/data/items/`, shows checkboxes with tooltip descriptions, enforces max-7 equip limit, and updates a live "ITEMS (N/7)" counter.

6. **Stacking/synergy framework** — All equipped items independently contribute through `_item_payout_contribution()` and are summed additively in `_get_item_payout_scalar()`. Each `effect_id` gets its own `match` branch. Future items with different effect types compose without overwriting.

**QA results (all 7 gates pass):**
| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| princess_check | pass |
| determinism_check | pass |
| rtp_audit | within target (0.793) |
| scene_smoke_check | pass (6 scenes) |
| bot_arc1_exterior | pass |
| bot_dialogue_loop | pass |
| item_balance_audit | captured (C1 overpowered, delta_rtp=+0.465) |

**QA recommendations for next chat:**
1. Tune C1 `per_reroll`/`cap` down to bring delta_rtp closer to neutral
2. Add rarity color indicators to dev picker for visual hierarchy
3. Add a deterministic synergy smoke test for multi-item stacking verification
4. For item C2 onward, verify coexistence with C1 (stacked loadout)
